audit.whatIsWrong: Content chart reads Teemo, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Teemo, Gragas, Gragas against the packet's Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Teemo. Full-layer phases carry the same three errors, and their ratings track the wrong side.
audit.why: The packet chart is what the page's own prose says. whys[2] (Level 3): 'He kites your long Barrel Roll and Body Slam cooldowns... while you still haven't maxed W' — that is a Teemo stage, marked Gragas. whys[4] (Level 6): 'runs a dashless Teemo down — no escape once you reach him' — a Gragas stage, marked Teemo. whys[6]: 'the map slips out of your control' — a Teemo stage, marked Gragas. Level 6 in particular is the one stage a Gragas player must be told he wins, and the chart tells him the opposite.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Teemo, with phases[2] and phases[6] dropped to 4/10 and phases[4] raised to 6/10.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Teemo owns 1-3 on Blinding Dart and Move Quick, Gragas takes 4-5 on W max plus Happy Hour, 6 is the Body Slam-into-Cask kill window, first item is peak, and shrooms plus splitpush flip it late. Matches the mirror's point 3, which located the stage advantage in Body Slam's near-flat cooldown against Teemo's flat 7s Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart is described only as 'Blinds your autos. Burst when it's down', with no statement of what it does NOT stop; Move Quick's defining weakness is never mentioned; and the page never names Move Quick, Toxic Shot, Noxious Trap or Guerrilla Warfare at all — it says 'passive move speed', 'poison (E)' and 'shrooms'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Blinding Dart blinds the target — autos only. Barrel Roll's blast and Body Slam's dash-stun both land in full through a blind, which is the entire reason Gragas can fight a Teemo who has his Q up, and the page currently teaches the player to wait out a flat 7-second cooldown he does not need to wait out. Move Quick's passive speed 'increases his Move Speed UNTIL he is struck by an enemy champion or turret' — so one Barrel Roll or one Body Slam strips the kite; only the 14s active sprint survives being hit. Guerrilla Warfare lets him hold invisibility while MOVING inside brush, which is the real reason facechecking loses the game, not just the traps.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart: flat 7s all ranks, 680 range, blinds autos only — abilities still land. Move Quick: 14s; passive speed drops the moment any champion or turret hits him, the active sprint does not. Toxic Shot is the on-hit poison, Noxious Trap the shrooms, Guerrilla Warfare the brush invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan'.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1. Against a flat 7s Blinding Dart that means he gets two blinds inside one whiffed Body Slam.
audit.corrected: 14 seconds at rank 1, versus his flat 7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the player that hitting Teemo turns off Move Quick's passive speed, or that a blind does not touch Gragas's abilities.
audit.why: Both are the hidden mechanics that decide whether the player can ever reach him. Landing anything on him removes the kite; being blinded does not remove his combo.
audit.corrected: Added to early, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: Teemo runs the first three levels — his blind (Q) wastes your Drunken Rage (W) empowered auto and shuts off the auto behind your Barrel Roll (Q), while his poison (E) and passive move speed chip and kite you. Worse, your early mana is thin, so don't burn Q chasing him through his move speed; you'll just whiff and have nothing for the next trade. Last-hit at the edge of Q's blast, eat the chip, and wait for the levels where W max lets you out-sustain him.
edits.after: Teemo runs the first three levels — Blinding Dart wastes your Drunken Rage (W) empowered auto and the auto behind your Barrel Roll, while Toxic Shot poisons and Move Quick kites; its passive speed drops the instant you hit him. Worse, your early mana is thin, so don't burn Q chasing him; you'll whiff and have nothing for the next trade. Last-hit at the edge of Q's blast, eat the chip, and wait for the levels where W max lets you out-sustain him.

notes: The packet defect 'never names any of Teemo's abilities' is HALF valid — Blinding Dart was named throughout the full layer, but Move Quick, Toxic Shot, Noxious Trap and Guerrilla Warfare appeared nowhere on the page. All four are now named where they matter. The mirror audit flags that the Teemo-side entry carried two fabricated Gragas mechanics (a barrel-stacking passive and a healing Barrel Roll puddle) and asks whether other Gragas entries repeat them — they do NOT appear in this entry; Happy Hour and Drunken Rage are described correctly here. Not asserted (absent from Riot's text): whether the blind's duration is reduced by tenacity, whether Explosive Cask's knockback can detonate or displace a placed Noxious Trap, and whether Body Slam collides with an invisible Teemo in brush. Recorded, not written.
